hook.text: Tesla Powerwalls store solar energy and sell it back to the grid during peak hours. Your home becomes a power plant.

buildup.text: Energy-as-a-service models let homeowners and businesses generate, store, and trade electricity directly.

discovery.text: Virtual power plants aggregate thousands of home batteries to sell stored energy during peak demand.

twist.text: Utilities lose revenue as customers generate their own power. They're lobbying to add fees for solar users.

climax.text: Decentralized energy challenges 100 years of centralized utility monopolies. The grid is becoming a marketplace.

punchline.text: Your roof generates power, your battery sells it. The grid is now a marketplace.

quiz.question: What is a virtual power plant?
options: Aggregated home batteries selling stored energy during peak demand
